title: 第一卷 第17章 前线战况大舅危在旦夕第一卷 第18章 迷雾森林寻找忘忧果
lines: 周丽婷瞬间被打懵了！
她素来好面子，不然也不会隐忍三年，直到获得正妻之位才嫁入侯府。
而今大庭广众之下，被人所掌掴，颜面尽失！
周丽婷如何能隐忍，紧紧捂着脸上的火红五指掌印，脸上带着不敢置信的神情道：“你！你居然敢打我，你知道我是谁吗？”
“你是谁？你又能是谁？”
苏晴雨目光不屑道：“不就是一个靠勾引他人夫君，趁机上位的小三吗？”
此言一出，整个大厅的气氛都变得凝固起来。
周丽婷气得七窍生烟，半天说不出一句话，竟当场大哭了起来，抱着姜文康的臂膀道：“夫君，她，她血口喷人！”
归根结底，还是苏晴雨的后台太硬了！
毕竟她的背后，可是传奇炼丹师北慕，这位桃李满天下的巨擘级人物，连皇族都要给其三分颜面。
小小北原城的镇北侯府与之比较，自然显得不够看。
姜文康脸色难看道：“苏姑娘，你这话说得有点太过火了吧！”
“过火吗？”
苏晴雨不以为然道：“别人不知道你家的事情，我却清清楚楚，宠妾灭妻之人，不会有什么好下场的！”
说罢，苏晴雨也不再多说，牵着叶无尘的手道：“徒儿，我们走！”
一时间，叶家之人也都兴高采烈地离开。
聚仙楼之人，一一散去。
只剩下镇北侯府的一行人愣在原地，依旧难以接受此事实。
第三次了！
这已经是姜牧野第三次输给了叶无尘。
好像自从二人正面交锋以来，姜牧野一直都处在劣势，从来就没赢过。
“这不应该啊……为什么我七品灵根的麒麟孙，没被苏姑娘看上，反而是那个三品灵根的废……”
姜老夫人失魂落魄，苦思冥想，甚至产生出了一丝怀疑，“难道我当年做出的决定是错的？”
“甚至如果我在一个月前，没有赶走叶琉璃、叶无尘母子二人的话，那么苏晴雨此刻加入的便是镇北侯府！”
一想至此，老夫人不禁懊悔。
那可是五品炼丹师啊，在此之前，整个北原城最厉害的炼丹师仅仅四品而已！
而且这还不是一般的五品炼丹师，背后有着北慕那样的大佬人物，如果能结交一二，也是天大的机缘。
结合以上种种，老夫人不禁捶胸顿足，后悔起来。
周丽婷见老夫人的情况，便察觉到不妙，连忙起身安慰道：“母亲大人，一个区区五品炼丹师而已，我牧儿有大帝之姿，将来必登临绝巅之位，哼，到了那时候，就让苏晴雨肠子悔青去吧！”
姜文康也点点头道：“我相信牧儿未来会找到更好的师父！”
“不错，我不会输给叶无尘的，一定不会！”
姜牧野紧紧握住了拳头，在心中暗暗立下誓言。
今日之耻辱，他未来必定百倍奉还！
叶府，张灯结彩，一派喜庆。
苏晴雨加入叶府，自然是顶天的大事，免不得大操大办一场酒宴。
“太好了，如今尘儿有了苏姑娘的教导，以后就算修行路被封堵，也能成为一名优秀的炼丹师！”
content_en:
Zhou Liting was stunned instantly!
She has always had a good reputation, otherwise she would not have withheld it for three years until she obtained the position of head wife before marrying into the Marquis's house.
Now, in public, he was slapped and his face was completely lost!
How could Zhou Liting endure it? She tightly covered the red five-finger palm prints on her face and said with an unbelievable look on her face: "You! How dare you hit me? Do you know who I am?"
"Who are you? Who can you be?"
Su Qingyu looked disdainfully and said, "Isn't she just a mistress who seduces other men's husbands and seizes the opportunity to gain power?"
As soon as these words came out, the atmosphere in the entire hall became solidified.
Zhou Liting was so angry that she couldn't say a word for a long time. She burst into tears on the spot. She hugged Jiang Wenkang's arms and said, "Husband, she, she is spitting blood!"
In the final analysis, Amelia Su's backstage is too tough!
After all, behind her is the legendary alchemist Bei Mu, a giant with so many celebrities all over the world that even the royal family has to give him some respect.
Compared with the Zhenbei Hou Mansion in Xiaobeiyuan City, it naturally seems inadequate.
Jiang Wenkang said with an ugly face: "Miss Su, what you said is a bit too much!"
"Is it too much?"
Su Qingyu said disapprovingly: "Others don't know about your family's affairs, but I know clearly that those who spoil their concubines and destroy their wives will not end up well!"
After that, Su Qingyu said no more, took Ye Wuchen's hand and said: "Disciple, let's go!"
For a time, everyone in the Ye family left happily.
The people in Juxian Tower dispersed one by one.
Only a group of people from the Zhenbei Hou Mansion were left standing there, still unable to accept this fact.
The third time!
This is the third time Jiang Muye has lost to Ye Wuchen.
It seems that ever since the two faced each other head-on, Jiang Muye has always been at a disadvantage and has never won.
"This shouldn't be...why is my Qilin grandson with seventh-grade spiritual roots not attracted by Miss Su, but instead is that useless person with third-grade spiritual roots..."
Mrs. Jiang was in a state of despair, thinking hard, and even had a hint of doubt, "Did I make the wrong decision back then?"
"Even if I hadn't driven away Ye Liuli and Ye Wuchen, mother and son, a month ago, then Su Qingyu would have joined the Zhenbei Hou Mansion now!"
Thinking about this, the old lady couldn't help but regret.
That was a fifth-grade alchemist. Before that, the most powerful alchemist in Beiyuan City was only a fourth-grade alchemist!
And this is not an ordinary fifth-grade alchemist. There is a big shot like Bei Mu behind him. If you can make friends with him, it will be a great opportunity.
Combining all the above, the old lady couldn't help but beat her chest and regret.
When Zhou Liting saw the old lady's condition, she sensed something was wrong and quickly stood up and comforted her: "Mother, I am just a fifth-grade alchemist. I, Mu'er, have the status of a great emperor and will surely reach the top in the future. Well, when the time comes, let Su Qingyu regret it!"
Jiang Wenkang also nodded and said: "I believe Mu'er will find a better master in the future!"
"That's right, I won't lose to Ye Wuchen, definitely not!"
Jiang Muye clenched his fist tightly and secretly made an oath in his heart.
He will definitely repay the humiliation he suffered today a hundredfold in the future!
…
Ye Mansion is decorated with lanterns and colorful decorations, making it look festive.
Su Qingyu's joining the Ye Mansion was naturally a big deal, so she couldn't avoid having a grand banquet.
"Great, now that Chen'er has Miss Su's teachings, even if her cultivation path is blocked in the future, she can still become an excellent alchemist!"
